whatIs: Toolbox by SignalSupply is a collection of small web design tools, currently in beta. It includes GradientBlob CSS (gradient blob backgrounds you copy as CSS), GradientBlob SVG, a pattern generator, Shapr (shapes such as squircle, star and sunburst), a blob generator and Perspectr, which applies perspective to an image you drag in.
It's a good fit when you need a quick decorative element, like a blob or a gradient background, and want to take it into your code as SVG or CSS.
uses: Generating an organic blob and copying it as SVG for a landing page hero.
Creating a background of gradient blobs and copying its CSS.
Building a pattern of geometric shapes and downloading it as SVG or PNG.
caveats: Some features are locked behind the PRO license: the GradientBlob SVG tool, several blob generators and most of the shapes in the pattern generator.
The free version of GradientBlob CSS is called Lite and is more limited than the full one.
The site is marked as beta, so the tools may change.
pricingNote: Several tools are free and PRO unlocks all of them for $3 per month or $35 per year.
idealFor: Designers and developers who need quick blobs, patterns and decorative backgrounds.
